notes: IMDBlackoutToken (src/IMDBlackoutToken.sol) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin v5.1.0 ERC-20 named IMDBlackout with symbol IMDBLACKOUT and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, the ProjectFactory on launch. There is no mint function, owner, minter role, proxy or upgrade path, so the supply can never grow. Holders may burn their own tokens through burn(uint256); there is no burnFrom. Transfers follow plain ERC-20 rules with no fee, tax, cooldown, cap, pause, blacklist, freeze, lock or seize, so the factory-to-distributor, distributor-to-claimant, pool seed and swap flows all move exactly the amount sent and no exemption list is needed. The brief's Transfer rules field named only the requester's wallet 0x6616cb624cec0b46c9718d423098150587d1272b and no rule; that address is exposed as the informational REQUESTER constant and has no power over the token. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. The runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT.
